  • Ample Storage Space: The portable metal tool box measures 21x 13.38 x 8.62 inches and weighs 21.49lbs, making it ideal for carrying tools while working on the go or storing them in your vehicle's trunk. It features 1 top box and 4 drawers
  • Auto-locking for Enhanced Security: The steel tool box features an auto-locking system. Make sure push the drawers in totally and close the top lid to lock it, avoiding accidental sliding and securing your tools. The heavy-duty metal latch keeps the top securely in place, while an additional lock hole allows you to add a lock for extra security, ensuring your valuable items are secure. (Note: To access the drawers, unlock by opening the top lid first.)
  • Smooth Operation for Easy Access: Opening the meta tool box becomes a smooth, effortless action with the well-designed hinge and tight-fitting lid providing splash protection. Each drawer is equipped with dual ball-bearing tracks for smooth, stable sliding, making it easy to pull out without worrying about getting stuck. The built-in EVA padding absorbs vibrations and avoids scratching or collisions, keeping everything secure and quiet.
  • Portable and Easy to Carry: With a convenient top handle, the drawer toolbox is easy to carry even when full of tools. The auto-locking system ensures your items stay secure during transport, avoiding any accidental spills and keeping you organized while on the move.
  • Sturdy and Durable: This toolbox with drawers is built to last, providing high resistance to deformation and impact. The powder-coated surface significantly enhances rust resistance, making it ideal for tough environments. The smooth metal surface is also easy to clean and maintain, providing hassle-free usage.
